input: Set up a side income tracker in a spreadsheet

gold.taskTitle: Build a Side Income Tracker in a Spreadsheet
gold.taskDescription: Set up a spreadsheet to track side income streams, earnings, and related financial details.

questions.title: Which spreadsheet tool will you be using?
questions.description: Identify whether the user will use Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, Apple Numbers, or another tool.

questions.title: How many different income streams are you tracking?
questions.description: Find out the number of separate side hustles or income sources the user wants to monitor.

questions.title: What types of side income are you earning?
questions.description: Understand the nature of the income, such as freelancing, selling products, rentals, dividends, or gig work.

questions.title: How often do you want to log your income entries?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user plans to log income daily, weekly, per transaction, or monthly.

questions.title: Do you also need to track related expenses or deductions?
questions.description: Determine if the tracker should account for costs tied to earning the side income, not just revenue.

questions.title: What is the main goal you want this tracker to show you?
questions.description: Understand the primary insight the user wants, such as total earnings, income by source, progress toward a goal, or tax estimates.

questions.title: Do you have an existing spreadsheet template or are you starting fresh?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a partial setup already or needs a complete build from scratch.
